The patch changes the shipped default to an action explicitly documented as unavailable for Promeo, making normal Text-to-Video generation fail closed for all users.

Review comment:

- [P1] Keep the default TTV action registered before switching models — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\src\controller\text_to_video\ttv_default_model_config.dart:153-153
  Because `TtvDefaultModelConfig.current` now uses this action id while it is not published for Promeo's sids, every default Text-to-Video generation reaches the credit lookup and fails with `TtvPricingError` before starting generation. Retain the currently registered configuration or gate this model switch until the action is registered for Promeo.

prs.author: JoeWu-CL
prs.title: Expose V2V generation as a headless, awaitable module with typed outcomes
prs.review_markdown:
The headless generation API leaves its optional busy-state publisher asserted forever after completion. This can permanently block callers that use the signal to manage availability.

Review comment:

- [P2] Release the headless busy signal on completion — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\src\controller\video_edit_by_chat\generation\v2v_headless_generation.dart:27-33
  When `busyPublisher` is supplied, generation start publishes `true`, but neither `onSucceeded` nor `onFailed` publishes `false`. A caller using this callback to control an agent or global busy state therefore remains permanently busy after the run completes; release it on terminal states, accounting for concurrent runs.

prs.author: JoeWu-CL
prs.title: Expose V2V generation as a headless, awaitable module with typed outcomes
prs.review_markdown:
The new headless lifecycle has a disposal race that can leave callers blocked and corrupt busy-state accounting when the object is reused. The remaining changes appear consistent with the existing lifecycle design.

Review comment:

- [P2] Complete in-flight requests when disposing — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\src\controller\video_edit_by_chat\generation\v2v_headless_generation.dart:101-106
  When `dispose()` clears `_pending`, every in-flight `generate()` loses its completer but continues waiting for the lifecycle backstop, which may remain blocked in polling or a long delay; this contradicts the documented abandonment behavior and can leave callers waiting indefinitely. It also resets `_runsInFlight` while those requests still execute, so reusing the instance before they finish can publish `busy=false` while a new request is active. Complete or cancel the pending requests and prevent their later `finally` blocks from corrupting the new instance state.

prs.author: AlexanderWang-cl
prs.title: Fix issue: Video Enhance compare alignment and seed-runner launch
prs.review_markdown:
The UI change and test appear consistent, but the QA script introduces a non-deterministic Flutter SDK selection that can break builds on machines with an outdated PATH-resolved SDK.

Review comment:

- [P2] Resolve Flutter without falling back to PATH — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\tools\qa\venh_seed_run.ps1:157-157
  When the repository-local SDK and `C:\flutter` are unavailable, this falls back to `Get-Command flutter`, which can select a stale `fvm/default` SDK and make the build fail with misleading dependency errors. Resolve an installed SDK explicitly instead, as required by [CLAUDE.md:87,122-125].
